description: Search, read, create and append the user's Abyss notes. Private notes are never returned or changed.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search the user's Abyss notes by words in the title, tags or text. Returns titles, tags and short snippets.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read one Abyss note by its title.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Exact note title (case does not matter).

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new Abyss note. Use [[Title]] in the body to link other notes.

tools.name: append_note
tools.description: Append text to an existing Abyss note.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title of the note to add to.
